environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The Envoy configuration includes an HTTP connection manager filter chain with a Lua filter that appends a response header `Content-Security-Policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; require-sri-for script` on all text/html responses. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration has a header-based request transformation that URL-encodes the `callback_url` query parameter value before forwarding to the upstream Actix service. The task IAM role has no outbound network permissions beyond the VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the default seccomp profile applied.

config.envoy_lua_filter: response header injection: Content-Security-Policy with script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com and require-sri-for script directive
config.envoy_route_transform: URL-encode callback_url query parameter values on inbound requests
config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, VPC endpoints only
config.outbound_access: restricted to ECR and CloudWatch VPC endpoints
